provenance.corpus: code-corpus-v1, this monorepo's own Python read as documents
provenance.not_citable: Both source repositories were dirty at emission, which the emitter's manifest flags. No run built on this corpus is citable until it is re-emitted clean; see docs/RESEARCH.md, code-style entry.
provenance.split: seed 0, holdout_fraction 0.1, 3993 train files and 443 holdout files
provenance.selection: 1 generated file, 68 duplicates and 38 empty files excluded; the duplicate check is by content, which is what matters here because scripts/guard.py is byte-identical across all 41 packages
provenance.named_by_digest: The train corpus is staged under its own sha256 because model_trainer.cluster.stores.StagedCorpus resolves corpus_dir/<file_id> and the file id IS the digest
provenance.read_by: modeltrainer-continuations, by path rather than by digest -- the sweep document names it, so it is not addressed by content the way the training corpus is
